scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of all-parameter phase diagram and separate finite rational checker; no claims beyond theorem or of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two exchangeable habitat patches with constant Markov transition rates and a simultaneous complete-clearance mechanism.
Two sign reversals require inhibitory colonization \(\(b<a\)/2\) and \(a>2e\); standard additive neighbour colonization \(b\ge a\) cannot exhibit this phase.
Stationary occupancy covariance is not extinction time, abundance synchrony or a validated field prediction.
Some earlier full manuscripts remain inaccessible; equivalent prior results under alternate terminology are possible.
title: Two-patch ecological occupancy covariance has a sharp catastrophe-driven double reversal
